Definition: Chezir, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Hezir is the name of two Israelites, one the head of the seventeenth course of priests and one a man who sealed the covenant after the exile. The priest Hezir stands in David's ordering of the temple service, and the later Hezir stands among the leaders who put their names to the sealed promise.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a name on the covenant is a serious thing, and Hezir's signature is a picture of a people binding themselves to God.
